children: stock rose 6.3% in Tuesday afternoon trading after a media report said private equity firms CD&R and Warburg Pincus are in advanced discussions to acquire Canaccord's British wealth management arm.

The two companies are negotiating a joint takeover of the business after they emerged from the auction process as the leading bidder, Reuters reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. Canaccord Wealth could be valued at over £1B ($1.34B), the news organization reported in October.
